footer.tagline: Calm, considered movement for busy professionals

hero.title: Move with intention.
hero.subtitle: Northside Pilates is a quiet, considered studio built around the schedules of busy professionals. Reformer and mat classes, capped at eight people, led by instructors who know your name.

classTypes.title: A format for every kind of schedule
classTypes.subtitle: From focused reformer work to recovery and stretch, every class is built around precise, controlled movement rather than sweat for its own sake.

items.title: Reformer Flow
items.description: A full-body reformer sequence built on controlled, flowing transitions.

items.title: Mat Foundations
items.description: Classical mat work focused on core control and posture, no equipment required.

items.title: Barre Fusion
items.description: Small isometric movements paired with reformer resistance for long, lean strength.

items.title: Private Sessions
items.description: One-to-one instruction tailored to injury recovery, specific goals, or simply your own pace.

items.title: Prenatal & Postnatal
items.description: Supportive, physician-informed sequencing for every stage of pregnancy and recovery.

items.title: Recovery & Stretch
items.description: Slow, guided mobility work to unwind tight hips, shoulders, and a desk-bound back.

philosophy.title: Built for people who sit in meetings all day
philosophy.subtitle: We designed the studio, the schedule, and the coaching style around the realities of a busy workweek.

items.title: Classes that fit your calendar
items.description: Early mornings, lunch hours, and evening slots, with online booking that updates in real time.

items.title: Capped class sizes
items.description: Every reformer class is kept small so instructors can correct your form, not just count reps.

items.title: Instruction over intensity
items.description: We care more about how you move than how hard you sweat. Technique first, always.

items.title: A studio that feels like an exhale
items.description: Warm light, quiet rooms, and a front desk that remembers your name and your usual mat.

instructors.title: Taught by people who take it seriously
instructors.subtitle: Every instructor at Northside trains year-round and teaches a small enough roster of clients to actually know how you move.

items.name: Mara Lindqvist
items.bio: Trained in classical and contemporary method across two decades, Mara built Northside around precision and patience.

items.name: Devon Osei
items.bio: A former dancer who brings musicality and control to every barre fusion class.

items.name: Priya Chandran
items.bio: Certified in prenatal and postnatal movement, Priya guides clients through every stage with care.

items.name: Tom Whitfield
items.bio: Tom's recovery sessions are the quiet reset most of our clients didn't know they needed.

pricing.title: Simple pricing, no surprises
pricing.subtitle: Try a single class or commit to a rhythm. Every plan includes access to the full class schedule.

plans.name: Drop-In
plans.description: Try a single class, no commitment.

plans.name: Monthly Unlimited
plans.description: Unlimited classes for clients who practice three or more times a week.

plans.name: Founding Member
plans.description: Our founding rate for early members, locked in for as long as you stay.

freeTrial.title: Your first class is on us
freeTrial.subtitle: Spend fifty minutes with us before you commit to anything. Bring a water bottle, we'll handle the rest.
freeTrial.successMessage: You're booked. Check your inbox for class details.

contact.title: Find us
contact.subtitle: Tucked just off the main strip, five minutes from the office district.
